name: S2 deadline decay: NO at -72h on BY markets
description: PRD v3 S2 test 2, the registered dynamic rule (research/studies/s2_deadline_decay/registration.yaml, registered_rules[0]) in DSL form. Universe: NO tokens of markets whose question has a BY deadline. Entry: NO price in [0.50, 0.90] while 60–72 hours remain to the scheduled end and the NO price has not risen more than 10% over the prior 7 days (the engine expresses the 'YES has not decayed' condition on the traded token). Hold to settlement. LIMIT +1 tick, TTL 5 bars, 2% of starting capital, one position per event. Runs on census collections at 60-minute bars.
